data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** A **GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY** unit of yours up to 8" from that enemy unit that is **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**.

**Effect:** The unit can carry out a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** of at most D6".
